title: Rename Legacy Package Names End To End

Updated package.json, project.json, imports, vitest/vite aliases, script.ts, launch.json, .storybook, semio/coda vite paths; regenerated bun.lock. Tests: playground renderer 4/4, puzzle 2d react 76/76, cad js core 336/336.
